remarks: A stunning residence in the highly sought-after Eastview Condominium, just 26 units. Loc in the Jefferson Elementary School district, this prime loc offers effortless access to schools, parks, shopping, highwys, restaurants, & public transportation-just minutes from Norwalk Hospital. Step inside this meticulously renovated & professionally designed home. The new custom white kit is a chef's dream, boasting ample cabinetry-complemented by decorative tiled flooring, shimmering quartz countertops, a high-end tiled backsplash, & premium stainless appls, including a B/I microwave. A corner cabinet w/ glass shelving adds a bespoke touch. Bathed in natural light from an abundance of windows & sliding doors, the spacious LR showcases wide-plank manufactured hdwd flooring, recessed lighting, crown molding, & direct access to a private deck w/ breathtaking city views. The stairway is adorned w/ ornate wrought iron spindles, adding a touch of timeless elegance. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring 2 generous W/I closets & a private balcony overlooking the city skyline. The spa-inspired en-suite bath is exquisitely finished w/ granite, custom tile work, a glass-enclosed shower w/ a rain showerhead & handheld fixture , and high-end vanity and fixtures. The 2nd bdrm offers hdwd flooring, an upscale ceiling fan, & access to another beautifully designed full ba w/ stylish tile & premium finishes. Other highlights include a reno half bath, recessed lighting throughout.
